articles.author: Inaya Folarin Iman
articles.title: Senior aides to U.K.'s Nigel Farage step down in donation scandal where reporter posed as wealthy American's son - CBS News
articles.description: Two senior aides to Nigel Farage, the firebrand leader of the U.K.'s populist Reform party, have stepped down in the wake of an investigative news report.
articles.content: Two senior aides to Nigel Farage, the firebrand leader of the U.K.'s populist Reform party, have stepped down after the party was accused of breaking British electoral law concerning foreign funding … [+6524 chars]
